newsitem.title: USA: Uroquest Medical says names Spraker CEO.
newsitem.headline: Uroquest Medical says names Spraker CEO.

text.p: UroQuest Medical Corp said Monday Eric Hale has resigned as president, chief executive officer and director and has been replaced by Terry Spraker.

Announcing that he has resigned to pursue other activities, Hale, 44, said, "The decision to leave UroQuest at this time was a difficult one. However, this change allows me to devote more time to several new entrepreneurial activities which have been presented to me recently."
Spraker, 48, previously served as president, EP Technologies, a division of Boston Scientific Corp, Uroquest said.
